integrity: Analytic proof of all-state separation and constructive sharpness. Accompanying finite numerical checks are illustrative, not a substitute for proofs or a demonstration of historical uniqueness. Full-text access to some older sampled-observability studies was unavailable.
scientific_limitations: Requires a common degradation rate, strict opposite monotonicities and finite upper cross-slope bounds. Does not classify unequal degradation rates or non-Lipschitz Hill responses. The endpoint permanent-alias example uses bounded C1 saturating regulation, whereas sharpness of the numerical constant within logistic regulation is an infimum of first-return times.
title: A sharp half-turn separation bound for monotone planar feedback trajectories
